rules.title: Weak debt-service capacity
rules.message: Estimated DSCR is below the configured 1.25x minimum.
rules.clear_message: Estimated DSCR is at or above the configured 1.25x minimum.
rules.recommended_action: Review repayment capacity and projected cash flows.

rules.title: High financial leverage
rules.clear_message: Debt-to-equity is within the configured 2.00x ceiling.
rules.recommended_action: Review the capital structure and consider additional equity support.

rules.title: Weak short-term liquidity
rules.message: Current ratio is below the configured 1.25x minimum.
rules.clear_message: Current ratio is at or above the configured 1.25x minimum.
rules.recommended_action: Review working-capital forecasts and liquidity support.

rules.title: Weak revenue growth
rules.message: Revenue growth is below the configured 10% benchmark.
rules.clear_message: Revenue growth meets or exceeds the configured 10% benchmark.
rules.recommended_action: Review revenue assumptions and downside scenarios.

rules.title: High loan-to-value ratio
rules.message: Calculated LTV exceeds the configured 75% ceiling.
rules.clear_message: Calculated LTV is within the configured 75% ceiling.
rules.recommended_action: Consider additional collateral or a lower facility amount.

rules.title: Limited realisable collateral coverage
rules.message: Realisable collateral coverage is below the configured 1.10x buffer.
rules.clear_message: Realisable collateral coverage meets the configured 1.10x buffer.
rules.recommended_action: Review recovery assumptions and consider additional security.

rules.title: Material collateral valuation haircut
rules.message: The difference between market and realisable collateral values exceeds 25%.
rules.clear_message: The collateral valuation haircut is within the configured 25% tolerance.
rules.recommended_action: Confirm valuation assumptions and collateral saleability.
